name: idle-agent-tools
description: Idle agent tools: a shared record of work for coding agents, and a multi-agent development workflow that runs with or without it.

plugins.name: idle-tasks
plugins.description: The record of work for agents: tasks that nest into trees, and memories (decisions, assumptions, taste, and retros). Four operations over MCP and the idle CLI; the system runs your project's checks when a task is submitted. PGlite locally, any Postgres when shared. Bring your own workflow; with idle-skills it also hands builders and reviewers their evidence, and retro and self-improve learn from finished work.

plugins.name: idle-skills
plugins.description: An interview turns what you want into a goal and a plan you own; the lead breaks it into goals, fresh agents build and review them, and you contradict what is not done. 7 skills. Works standalone or on a task tracker.
